key: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward the Father of the earth, Father of heaven: Father of Agni, Surya’s generator, the Father who begat Indra and Visnu.
s: After a shared prayer for welfare, the hymn turns to Soma’s titles; Sāyaṇa, on 9.96.5, reads all this begetting as coming to pass at the pressing, since Soma strengthens the gods, and Indra’s begetting as the gladness he stirs when drunk.
src: Sāyaṇa, Vedārthaprakāśa on Rig Veda 9.96.5, sa.wikisource ऋग्वेदः सूक्तं ९.९६, revision 307921 (2021)

evidence.words: “दिवः द्युलोकस्य “जनिता प्रादुर्भावयिता तथा “पृथिव्याः जनयिता “अग्नेः जनयिता प्रकाशयिता “सूर्यस्य सर्वस्य प्रेरकस्यादित्यस्य “जनिता “इन्द्रस्य “जनिता पानेन मदस्य जनयिता “उत अपि च “विष्णोः ब्यापकस्य “जनिता जनयिता । एतत् सर्वं सोमेऽभिषूयमाणे भवतीति । सोमो हि देवानाप्याययतीति
evidence.gloss: Further, begetter of heaven, the one who makes it appear, and begetter of earth; begetter of Agni, the one who makes him shine; begetter of Sūrya, the sun who sets all things moving; begetter of Indra: by being drunk, begetter of his exhilaration; and also begetter of Viṣṇu, the pervader. All this comes about when Soma is being pressed; for Soma makes the gods swell with strength.
evidence.licence: public domain text; transcription CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikisource)

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, ref 9.96.5, at [818,5]). Sāyaṇa on 9.96.5 glosses Indra’s janitā as pānena madasya janayitā (by being drunk, begetter of his exhilaration) and closes: etat sarvaṃ some ’bhiṣūyamāṇe bhavati, somo hi devān āpyāyayati (all this happens when Soma is pressed, for Soma strengthens the gods). The sentence carries exactly this. Plain sense: 9.96.4 is a prayer for welfare voiced as the wish of the assembled friends and the singer, and 9.96.5 to 6 list Soma’s titles; faithful. Revision 307921 dated 2021-04-22. Evidence is a contiguous span of the packet (the proposer’s basis used an ellipsis). entry-check ok.
